info.description: PixVerse video generation model for text-to-video and image-to-video only, with optional native audio. Clips are 1-15 seconds at 360p, 540p, 720p or 1080p in eight aspect ratios. First/last frame, multi-subject references, video references and video extend are not supported. The API bills in credits (225 credits = USD 1): 6, 9, 11 and 22 credits per second at 360p to 1080p without audio, and 9, 11, 15 and 28 with audio.

zh.description: PixVerse 视频生成模型，目前只支持文生视频和图生视频，可选原生音频。片段时长 1-15 秒，分辨率 360p、540p、720p 或 1080p，支持八种画幅比例。不支持首尾帧、多主体参考、视频参考和视频延长。API 以积分计费（225 积分 = 1 美元）：无音频时 360p 至 1080p 每秒 6、9、11、22 积分，有音频时每秒 9、11、15、28 积分。
